title: Renewal that re-lays the train with high priority seats
why: Priority-seat dimensions are mandatory only if achievable without reducing capacity, which the spec cannot show.

spec.name: Renewal that re-lays the train with high priority seats

priority_seats.cushion_height_mm.required: 430–500 mm, unless it would reduce capacity
priority_seats.cushion_height_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.1.2.1(9): 520 > 500. Appendix F, Seats: 'only mandatory if the seating layout is altered within an entire train and this can be achieved without reducing the existing capacity of the train'. A person must judge capacity.
